inspiration: One 32x32 base grid for everything, with taller 32x48 frames reserved for bosses so they read as bigger.
Monsters built from a base skin set crossed with job overlays; many distinct looks from few pieces.
Elemental dragons: one silhouette per element with a distinct hue, wing or body shape, plus a portal effect.
Projectiles drawn in eight directional frames at 32x32, so arrows read correctly in top-down play.
Armour pieces come in a plain and an ornate art variant: plain for play, ornate for display.
Vault layouts stored as ASCII glyph stamps with doors and symmetric corridors (per simple.des); a cheap zone-design method.
Splash-art portraits for characters and monsters (41 title files); style not viewed.
